title: Didn't Work Well for Cheesecake
text:
Didn't Work Well for Cheesecake. I ordered this cake ring because I lost the bottom of my springform pan and figured I'd give this a try. After making a cheesecake, I found I much prefer using a springform pan so I went out and bought a new one. Because I do not make multi-layered cakes, I'm giving the cake ring to my sister in law who does make layered cakes. I'm sure she'll get plenty of use out of it.

It is very easy to clean (I cleaned by hand) .

product_metadata.title: Menz Stahlwaren GmbH Cake ring – Made in Germany – Stainless steel cake mold adjustable and can be fixed with clips – 3.3” high – for magical cake creations
features: Robust and durable, Made in Germany – Cake rings are ideal for those who love creating unique multi-layered, sponge, or theme cakes; made of robust, strong stainless steel, neutral in odour and taste; may be put in the freezer compartment if quick cooling of cake filling is required.

Easy to adjust and securely fixed – Thanks to two handles, adjusting the 3.3” tall cake ring – infinitely adjustable from 6.3 – 12” - to the desired size can be done effortlessly; the selected size is fixed by means of three large and two small clips to prevent shifting; with scaling.

Filling and layering cakes as easy as pie - With its height of 3.3”, the adjustable cake mould is ideal for preparing sponge and multi-layered cakes; cream fillings or cake glazes can set in the cake ring without leaking out; the adjustable cake ring can then be removed easily without damaging the cake by widening the ring.
Easy-care and dishwasher-safe – The cake baking mould can be washed either by hand or in the dishwasher as it is made of stainless steel, 100% rustproof; simply pull apart for cleaning.

For baking, as a substitute for springform pans – Baking rings without bottom provide the best baking results by optimal heat distribution; in this case, however, the mousse cake molds should be used together with baking paper to prevent cake batter from leaking out.
